newsitem.title: JAPAN: TIFFE euroyen slides in Tokyo after tankan.
newsitem.headline: TIFFE euroyen slides in Tokyo after tankan.

text.p: The benchmark three-month March euroyen futures contract had slid sharply by mid-morning Tokyo on Wednesday after the Bank of Japan (BOJ)'s tankan report came out stronger than expected, traders said.
March was down by 0.18 to 98.76 at 0105 GMT after ranging from 98.75 to 98.98.
Although euroyen futures are likely to remain fragile over the short-term, their slide today may well come to a halt shortly on technical factors, one city bank trader said.
Key overnight call money was being traded around 0.52 percent after the BOJ injected 200 billion yen this morning.
